services.desc: Wahoo fishing in Fort Lauderdale with YB Normal Sportfishing can be outstanding when the conditions and timing line up. These lightning-fast predators are one of the most exciting offshore species to target, and certain moon phases can make the bite even better. In particular, the week leading up to a full moon and the days around a new moon are often the most productive times to pursue these incredible fish. Among offshore game fish, the wahoo stands in a class of its own. The Atlantic sailfish may be known for speed, and tuna are famous for their brute strength, but the wahoo combines bothinto one unforgettable fight.
